paragraphs: Tahlif, the father of Ravna Huzaya. In Beitzah 15, end of side b: R' Tahlifa, the brother of Ravnai Huzaya; see his entry. In Rif, Kol Kitvei: R' Tahlifa, the father—or some say brother—of Ravnai Huzaya. So too in Asheri, Beitzah.
